title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
abstract: arXiv:2611.01284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). translated_title: 大语言模型小说中的角色名字集中现象：测量偏移与缓解重复
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）创作的小说中，角色名字集中于诸如“Elara”和“Elias”等少数反复出现的名字上，这是“AI垃圾内容”（AI slop）可被测量的一种表现。现有的修复方法要么需要访问logits或重新训练模型，要么仅针对单次请求运作，无法在语料库层面控制集中度。提示级策略能在多大程度上降低这种集中度、又会对名字自然度造成多大损失，此前尚未得到系统性测量。我们对八种策略的名字集中度控制开展了实证研究，并提出“推测式命名”——一种无需微调的方法，它将推测解码的“草拟-验证-拒绝”范式从token层面迁移到名字层面。该方法通过语言化采样请求候选名字集合，使用结合了每个模型指纹与运行时计数器的SlopTracker对候选名字进行评分，并通过温度控制规则或其严格变体（HARD）进行选择。我们使用20个大语言模型生成了44,782篇故事，涵盖四种语……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出无需微调的“推测式命名”方法，将推测解码的草拟-验证-拒绝范式从token迁移到角色命名，配合结合模型指纹与运行时计数器的SlopTracker评分机制，有效缓解了LLM小说中角色名字集中于少数高频名字（如Elara、Elias）的问题。
